bull.b: Sustained ~90% gross margins alongside TTM revenue growth (+20.2%) imply attractive unit economics for its muscle-targeted therapies. Early uptake—initial product sales, growing prescriber base, REMS certifications and rising patient enrollments—reduces commercialization execution risk. bear.t: Significant cash burn & negative free cash flow
